actual_ordinary_flow_contract:
def OrdinaryFlowFamilyTameBounds (T : MaterialData) (S : PhysicalSpacesData)
    (C : NonlinearGeometryData S) (base loss : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ parameterLoss : ℕ, ∀ s : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ m a b p,
    a + b ≤ s → p.1 ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) →
    ∃ J : SmoothDirections (stateNeighborhood S C base ε) (ordinaryFlowFamily S C m a b p),
      ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε, ∀ v : Fin k → (AnnularState S × ℝ),
        min (p.1 - C.left m) (C.right m - p.1) ^ a * |J.D k z v| ≤
          B * T.H (T.sample (C.cell m)) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) *
          T.E0 (T.sample (C.cell m)) ^ B *
          oneHighVariationWeight (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading)
            base (s + loss + parameterLoss) (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) v
unchanged_coefficient_contract:
def CoefficientFamilyTameBounds (D : ReferenceData) (T : MaterialData)
    (S : PhysicalSpacesData) (C : NonlinearGeometryData S)
    (base loss : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k s : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ m i a b p,
    a + b ≤ s → p.1 ∈ D.cells m →
    ∃ J : SmoothDirections (stateNeighborhood S C base ε) (coefficientFamily D S C i a b p),
      ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε, ∀ v : Fin k → (AnnularState S × ℝ),
        |J.D k z v| ≤ B * T.H (T.sample m) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) *
          T.E0 (T.sample m) ^ B *
          oneHighVariationWeight (pairGrading (stateGrading S) realGrading)
            base (s + loss) (z - (C.referenceState, 0)) v

/-- Uniform ordinary-flow estimates on the same fixed state neighbourhood.
The additional loss may depend on the number of parameter derivatives, but
not on the spatial order, component, evaluation point, state or increments.
This is the quantifier order in the manuscript's `eq:tame-derivative-shape`;
ordinary smooth tame flow calculus does not give a loss uniform in `k`. -/
